column101: As a boarder of four years and currently naghahanap ng boarding house in a different place, the floor plan, the rate, and the number of beds in the house aren't just the things I look at in a boarding house. What else does that place offer? Do you have TV? Can I use the kitchen, is it shared? Do you have a shared CR? Maybe you can add them? Does it have a curfew? It would have been better if you had pictures of the inside, too. You might say you have the inquiry button for that. But boarding house hunters only inquire when they're sufficiently interested OR when they have no other choice for a boarding house (can they even find your website then) OR if someone actively advertised this website to them.   Did you attach this website to the google map of this boarding house? (The name of your place in google maps is 4PRJ+P4J) I think this will be a good idea. Some boarders look for boarding houses in google maps. Putting that there might make the website more reachable.
